# 🚀 Report Release Checklist

## Artifact integrity
- [ ] PBIX opens.
- [ ] Workbook source is identified.
- [ ] Source path and refresh behavior verified.
- [ ] Release copy backed up.

## Analytical correctness
- [ ] Sales reconciled.
- [ ] Order definition validated.
- [ ] Quantity reconciled.
- [ ] Time comparisons tested.
- [ ] Ranking behavior reviewed.

## Presentation
- [ ] All report pages reviewed.
- [ ] Filters and interactions tested.
- [ ] Labels, formats, and units reviewed.
- [ ] Real screenshots updated.
- [ ] Sensitive data removed from screenshots.

## Documentation
- [ ] Data dictionary updated.
- [ ] DAX catalogue updated.
- [ ] Model and architecture updated.
- [ ] Known limitations recorded.
- [ ] Links validated.

## Publishing and handoff
- [ ] Sharing permissions reviewed.
- [ ] Credentials handled securely.
- [ ] Refresh owner assigned if applicable.
- [ ] Rollback copy retained.
- [ ] Release notes updated.
